name: RaisAI Festival Theme Engine asset library

aiInstructions.selection: Choose by festival id and semantic role. Use micro assets for small surfaces, main ornaments for hero or empty-state emphasis, and ui-kit sheets only when the renderer supports cropping by normalized regions.
aiInstructions.placement: Keep decoration beside or behind content, never over primary text, form labels, validation messages, navigation controls, or financial values.
aiInstructions.scale: Use micro assets at 16-96px, role crops at 24-180px, and main ornaments at 96-420px. Preserve transparent padding and do not stretch disproportionately.
aiInstructions.accessibility: Decoration is supplementary. Keep contrast and readable text independent of the image, use empty alt text when decorative, and never encode meaning only in color or imagery.
aiInstructions.safety: Do not combine sacred motifs with playful error states, payment failures, or marketing claims. Avoid cultural caricature.

main-ornament.description: Large centered transparent 3D festival object establishing the theme identity.
main-ornament.placement: Right side of a hero, corner of an empty state, or centered in a preview with 20% clear space.

micro-decoration.description: Small transparent accent adding a quiet festive signal without competing with content.
micro-decoration.placement: Use one accent per local surface, usually in a corner at low opacity.

button-background.description: Upper-left ui-kit panel: compact decorative texture behind a button label while preserving text contrast.
button-background.placement: Use as a masked layer inside a button-sized surface; keep the label in HTML above it.

button-side-icon.description: Upper-right ui-kit panel: compact motif beside a button label as a visual cue.
button-side-icon.placement: Crop the upper-right region and render at 16-28px beside the label.

avatar-icon.description: Lower-left ui-kit panel: friendly abstract festival emblem or avatar head for circular UI containers.
avatar-icon.placement: Crop to a square, apply a circular mask only with safe padding, and render at 24-64px.

avatar-presenting-product.description: Lower-right ui-kit panel: small festival host or abstract character presenting a generic product card, for product education without implying a real person.
avatar-presenting-product.placement: Crop the lower-right region and place beside explanatory copy, usually on the right side of a card.

navigation-badge.description: Compact emblem for a navigation item, sidebar label, tab, or seasonal mode indicator.
navigation-badge.placement: Crop the first utility-kit cell and render at 16-24px with a readable text label beside it.

notification-accent.description: Small celebratory accent for a non-critical success or informational notification.
notification-accent.placement: Crop the second utility-kit cell and keep it visually secondary to the message.

card-corner-flourish.description: Corner decoration that adds festival identity to a feature card without reducing content area.
card-corner-flourish.placement: Crop the third utility-kit cell and anchor it to the top-right or bottom-left corner at low opacity.

modal-header-ornament.description: Wide horizontal flourish for a modal or dialog header, intended to establish context without competing with the title.
modal-header-ornament.placement: Crop the fourth utility-kit cell, keep it behind or beside the heading, and preserve a clear text zone.

empty-state-helper.description: Friendly abstract object for an empty workspace, no-results screen, or first-run guidance state.
empty-state-helper.placement: Crop the fifth utility-kit cell and center it above the explanation and primary action.

loading-accent.description: Calm circular festive motif that can accompany a progress indicator without pretending to show actual progress.
loading-accent.placement: Crop the sixth utility-kit cell and render beside the real progress indicator; do not animate the image unless loop-safe.

section-divider.description: Thin decorative horizontal separator that visually groups related content while remaining subordinate to headings.
section-divider.placement: Crop the seventh utility-kit cell and place between sections with sufficient vertical spacing.

input-decoration.description: Subtle edge motif for a search, prompt, or filter input; it should never look like an interactive control by itself.
input-decoration.placement: Crop the eighth utility-kit cell and place at the far edge of the input with padding from the cursor and clear button.

utilityKit.description: Neutral transparent 4x2 utility sheet containing eight reusable festive interface decorations: navigation badge, notification accent, card-corner flourish, modal-header ornament, empty-state helper, loading accent, section divider, and input decoration.
utilityKit.recommendedUse: Use this neutral sheet across all festival themes, then pair it with the selected festival's main ornament, micro decorations, and ui-kit sheet. Crop by grid cell rather than stretching the full sheet.
avoid: showing the entire sheet in production UI
using decoration as a status or permission signal
